Under general direction, serves as an administrative and human resources advisor to department leadership and provides a full range of administrative operations support in the areas of personnel administration, Employee and Labor Relations, compensation, organizational planning, credentialing, fellowship administration, and professional development programs.
25% - Advanced Practice Fellowship Program

Provides confidential consultation and support to departmental leadership regarding workforce planning, employee relations matters, corrective actions, investigations, organizational structure, compensation recommendations, leave administration, and personnel actions. Regularly accesses, analyzes, prepares, and maintains sensitive and confidential information related to employee relations matters, disciplinary actions, investigations, grievances, compensation actions, organizational planning, and management deliberations. Exercises a high degree of judgment, discretion, and independent decision-making while safeguarding confidential information and supporting leadership in personnel-related matters.
30% - Personnel Management
The position reports directly to the Patient Care Services Business Director.
25% - Credentialing and Privileging

This position regularly supports management in the administration of sensitive personnel, employee relations, and labor relations matters. The incumbent has ongoing access to confidential information related to disciplinary action, performance management, employee complaints, investigations, grievances, grievance analysis and strategy, bargaining positions and strategy related to meet-and-confers over changes in working conditions, compensation recommendations, organizational planning, workforce analyses, personnel transactions, management discussions, and other matters not available to represented employees.
15% - Professional Development

The incumbent prepares and maintains confidential materials used by leadership in evaluating employee and labor relations matters, developing grievance analysis and strategy, evaluating bargaining positions and strategy for meet-and-confers regarding changes in working conditions, making personnel decisions, and supporting workforce planning and organizational management activities. A high degree of discretion and independent judgment is required when handling confidential information. #CA-DS
5% - Other Duties as Needed
Knowledge of Credentialing and privileging process for Advanced Practice Providers
Strong knowledge of recruitment, selecting, training and employee retention and corrective/disciplinary action processes
Strong knowledge of strategic planning, developing, managing and executing short- and long-term goals/plans
Exceptional analytical, administrative and interpersonal problem-solving skills
Solid persuasion, listening and conflict management skills

Decision-making skills to independently exercise delegated authority to act, and to recognize when it is appropriate to seek assistance from others when limits of delegated authority have been reached

Demonstrated ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential personnel, employee relations, labor relations, investigation, compensation, disciplinary, and organizational planning information while exercising sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism
Complete working knowledge of, and skill to apply, practices, principles and techniques related to area of expertise
Knowledge of state and federal labor and employment laws and regulations
